audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Lucian while whys[4] says his all-in beats The Culling, and 2+ items read Jax while whys[6] says you reclaim the very late game.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lucian, Skill, Jax, Jax, Jax, Jax, Lucian. The mirror flipped exactly these two rows and left the rest, which already agreed.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side to Jax and win[6]/phases[6].side to Lucian as matched pairs, ratings inverted, and both phases[N].why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Counter Strike governs every field on the page and its cooldown never appears; Empower has no timer either.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s — enormous at rank 1 and the reason the level-3 window is survivable at all. Empower is 7/6/5/4/3s and is an auto-attack reset, so its wind-up rather than its cast is the cue to step back.
audit.corrected: The 17s figure into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, tldr, report[0].t and breakdown.cooldowns; Empower's reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields say Counter Strike 'dodges every auto', 'eats your whole string', 'negates your autos' — with nothing said about what it does NOT stop.
audit.why: Riot's text: Jax dodges all incoming ATTACKS for a short duration. Basic attacks. Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze are abilities and land through the stance. The page as written tells a Lucian to stop doing anything for the whole duration, when the correct play is to keep casting Q and hold only the autos.
audit.corrected: The attacks-not-abilities distinction written into tldr, report[0].t, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, wants.you[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Counter Strike's stun arms Lightslinger is left unstated in both directions.
audit.why: Lucian's passive reads 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized'. Jax stunning LUCIAN does not immobilize an enemy champion, so on the literal text it should not trigger. The mirror declined to write it for the same reason. I did not write it either — see questionsForUser.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Grandmaster-at-Arms adds armour, MR and a third-hit AoE stun — his all-in beats The Culling outright.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: You reclaim the very late game only at range — fire The Culling once he has already committed, and never duel him.

edits.before: Counter Strike eats your whole string — autos are your kit and he dodges all of them. Trade only while his E is down, and respect the scaling cliff.
edits.after: Counter Strike eats your autos but not your abilities — Q and W land through it. Trade in its 17s downtime, and respect the scaling cliff.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges every auto and stuns — hold your damage until it ends. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1, and it dodges basic attacks only: Q and W land through the stance. - Empower is a 3-7s auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Bait out his E dodge by holding autos, then double-shot the window after it expires
edits.after: Hold your autos through the dodge stance but keep casting Q — abilities are not dodged

edits.before: This is where Jax takes the lane. With E Counter Strike up he holds the dodge, negates your double-tap autos, and stuns you the instant you commit — so trade only in the window right after his E expires, then dash out. At 6 his R stacks armor and MR and adds a third-hit AoE stun; your Culling channel no longer wins the all-in and he can simply Q-W onto you and burst your squishy HP. Farm, ping for ganks, and stop dueling him.
edits.after: This is where Jax takes the lane. With Counter Strike up he holds the dodge, negates your double-tap autos, and stuns you the instant you commit — but it eats basic attacks, not abilities, so keep Piercing Light flowing and save the autos for the window after it expires, then dash out. At 6 Grandmaster-at-Arms stacks armour and MR and adds a third-hit AoE stun; The Culling no longer wins the all-in. Farm, ping for ganks, stop dueling.

notes: The whole page treated Counter Strike as a blanket damage immunity. It dodges ATTACKS — Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze go through it, which turns a dead 17-second window into one where you still poke. That is the highest-value correction here. All four packet suspectNames were already confirmed false positives by the mirror and I did not touch those names. Two chart rows flipped as matched pairs, exactly the two the mirror moved.
